detailed_description: Color Blindness Simulator helps designers and developers test how their colors and images appear to people with various types of color vision deficiency. Supports protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia, and complete color blindness simulation.
usage_steps: Select a color using the color picker or enter a hex code
Optionally upload an image to test
Click on different color blindness types to see simulations
Compare how the color appears across all types
Use the image preview to see full image simulations
usage_examples: Test website color schemes for accessibility
Verify chart and graph colors are distinguishable
Ensure UI elements are visible to all users
